terms.grammar: with the accusative of the place
evidence: Cic. N.D. 2.125: gruēs loca calidiōra petentēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: To make for a place: Ītaliam petere.

terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, intransitive, with ad + acc.

phrases.latin: Viātōrēs deinde terrēnō itinere Athēnās petēbant?
phrases.english: Did the travellers then head overland for Athens?

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Lewis & Short: peto
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
